chunks: When he had given them their provisions he put his goblet in his brother's saddle-bag. Then a crier announced: "O men of the caravan, you are thieves."

key_terms.السِّقَايَةَ: The drinking cup or goblet used by the king

ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Joseph set the trap for his brothers to keep Benjamin with him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this event is viewed as a divinely orchestrated test (ibtila') where Joseph employed strategic wisdom (hikmah) to fulfill the prophecy of his father Jacob, ensuring Benjamin remained in Egypt as a sign of divine justice. The placement of the cup symbolizes the transition from the brothers' initial betrayal to their eventual redemption through the younger brother's steadfastness.
